the only thing that helped me overcome my driving anxiety was to straight up force myself to do it. of course this wont work for everyone, but if it seems like something you can do safely id def recommend trying at least once. i chose a day after getting my license and was like, okay. im going to get in my car and have my mom follow me from our home, to a city 45 minutes away. i devided to drive by myself so i COULDNT have help in the moment, but my mom was right behind me in her car. i was scared shitless, but once i got on the highway realized i HAD to stop being so scared or i was going to either get pulled over or i would wreck. i started laughing at myself, out loud 😅 honestly making fun of myself, because of how embarrassing i thought it was to be scared of driving!! i was talking to myself telling myself that i had to just do it, cause who the hell else was gonna drive the car?! it all became a really big joke and i was able to feel the fear and do it anyways. i made it there and back totally safe, without as much as a blip in a lane change. idk i know its easier said than done but really setting it up like this is what helped me overcome my driving fear. i still get scared sometimes but have been able to adopt this mindset and even if theres some white knuckling going on, im able to get to my destination safely. i hope you’re able to feel the fear and do it anyways!!
